suites.title: E2E-1 registration → login → pricing → plan → checkout

specs.title: a new visitor reaches the checkout page for the plan they picked
checkout and dashboard are inaccessible when signed out (redirect to login with a safe return path)
invalid registration input shows a clear message without leaking details
wrong password shows a generic error
customer pays; backend verifies; subscription activates exactly once; dashboard reflects it
failure screen is shown and no subscription is activated
after a failure the customer can try again and succeed

open redirect via ?next= is neutralised

specs.title: a forged ?status=success in the URL cannot turn a FAILED payment into a success
a forged success redirect for an UNPAID (pending) order shows pending and activates nothing
result page handles malformed order ids safely
double-clicking Pay creates one order; replayed callbacks never create a second subscription
buying the same plan again while a subscription is active is refused with a friendly message
